data.name: Asyirah
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘as-sawar’, meaning a small seed. The name Asyirah symbolizes growth and rebirth, reflecting the idea that even the smallest of seeds holds immense potential. This name is often given to babies born during the spring season, when new life is beginning to sprout and blossom.

This name is a reminder that even the smallest of seeds can grow into a mighty tree, given the right conditions and nurturing.
